name: 六合
detail: 六合 describes six paired Earthly Branch relationships. Traditionally it can suggest connection or cooperation, but it does not guarantee that a particular event will go well. Other relationships, context and complete charts can change the interpretation.

name: 三合
summary: Four elemental groups of three branches.
detail: 三合 groups branches into Water (申子辰), Wood (亥卯未), Fire (寅午戌), and Metal (巳酉丑). Two branches can belong to the same group, but this site labels that only as a shared group, not a complete 三合局.

name: 六冲
detail: 六冲 pairs are 子午、丑未、寅申、卯酉、辰戌、巳亥. Traditional interpretations often emphasize movement, tension or adjustment; a clash alone is not proof of misfortune.

name: 六害
summary: A separate set of disruptive branch pairings.
detail: 六害 relationships are traditionally associated with friction or lack of ease. They can coexist with another relationship classification, so the engine preserves all applicable labels.

name: 相刑
summary: Self, paired and multi-branch punishment conventions.
detail: 相刑 includes the 子卯 pair, self-punishment for 辰午酉亥, and multi-branch patterns such as 寅巳申 and 丑未戌. Two members of a three-branch group are not automatically presented as the complete punishment formation.

name: 相破
detail: 相破 may be read as interruption or a need for repair. It is a distinct relationship from 六冲 and 六害; relationships may overlap.

name: 三会
detail: 三会 groups 寅卯辰 for Wood, 巳午未 for Fire, 申酉戌 for Metal, and 亥子丑 for Water. Sharing a seasonal group with another branch is not the same as a complete meeting of all three branches.

name: 干支与节气
summary: The calendar foundation for year, month and day.
detail: The year pillar changes at 立春, the month pillar follows the solar-term 节 boundaries, and the day pillar follows the chosen midnight-based local calendar convention. Popular birth-year animal conventions may instead switch at Lunar New Year. Calculations depend on the selected calendar time zone.
